sampling: Uniform without replacement after excluding known rank-training, budget-training and calibration questions; freeze IDs and input hashes before inference. If fewer than 100 eligible examples remain, report the shortage rather than duplicate examples.
model: Same Llama model and tokenizer as the completed S/A/B experiment; verify paths and hashes before launch.

generation.prompt: Reuse repository LongBench task prompts and the same model chat template for every method.
generation.truncation: Same middle truncation only above 32768 tokens; regenerate from original contexts, assert identical task/source IDs to 8K run.
generation.prefill: Full attention shared across methods as in the prior S/A/B implementation; sparse selection starts during decode.

report_by_task: mean answer token F1 using repository scorer
paired B-minus-A and each sparse-minus-full score differences
paired bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals and wins/ties/losses
logical and padded KV slot fractions
generation length and fraction reaching generation limit
prefill, indexing, decode and total time separately
evaluated input length distribution and truncated example fraction
length-stratified scores and costs where sample sizes permit
preservation: Use a new remote output directory; do not overwrite checkpoints or prior results.
pending: Verify longest selected input and run the frozen-checkpoint evaluation.
